GroupingFields.description_en:
An array of alert event group objects.

If you do not specify the groupingFields field, all alerts will be sent to contacts based on `alertname`.
If you specify the groupingFields field, alerts with the same field will be sent to contacts in one notification
GroupingFields.description_zh:
设置事件分组。


不填（默认）：所有告警会按`alertname`分组发送给处理人。
设置分组字段：相同字段的告警内容会分别通过独立信息发送给处理人

Repeat.description_en:
Indicates whether the system resends notifications for a long-lasting unresolved alert. Valid values:

`true` (default): The system resends notifications for a long-lasting unresolved alert at a specified time interval.
`false`: The system resends notifications for a long-lasting unresolved alert based on an escalation policy
Repeat.description_zh:
对于长期未解决的告警是否发送重复通知。

`true`（默认）：按设置的重复通知时间间隔发送通知。
`false`：根据设置升级策略发送通知

RepeatInterval.description_en: The time interval at which a notification is resent for a long-lasting unresolved alert. Unit: seconds
RepeatInterval.description_zh: 重复通知时间间隔，单位为秒

SendRecoverMessage.description_en:
Indicates whether the status of an alert automatically changes to Resolved when all events related to the alert change to the Restored state. The system sends a notification to the alert contacts when the alert status changes to Resolved.

`true` (default): The system sends a notification.
`false`: The system does not send a notification
SendRecoverMessage.description_zh:
当告警下面全部事件都恢复时，告警状态是否自动恢复为已解决。当告警恢复时，系统将会发送通知给处理人。

`true`（默认）：发送通知。
`false`：不发送通知

State.description_en: Indicates whether the notification policy is enabled. Valid values: enable and disable
State.description_zh: 通知策略是否启用，enable 启用，disable 停用
